Madsen et al Denmark cohort study (n=537303) finds no MMR-autism link
Brian Deer exposes Wakefield conflict of interest and litigation funding
Ten of twelve Lancet co-authors retract the paper's interpretation
Honda et al Yokohama study: MMR vaccination stopped, autism rates continued rising
Wakefield continues public advocacy despite withdrawn interpretation
GMC opens fitness-to-practise hearing against Wakefield
Smeeth UK GP cohort: no association between MMR and autism
GMC finds Wakefield guilty of professional misconduct and dishonesty
Lancet fully retracts the 1998 Wakefield paper
GMC removes Wakefield from UK medical register
BMJ publishes Deer series concluding Wakefield's research was an elaborate fraud
Meta-analysis of 1.2M children: no association between MMR and autism
